settings.title: PCI-DSS LEVEL 1 ENCRYPTION
settings.body: All payment credentials are processed exclusively via Shopify’s encrypted checkout infrastructure. QIRÉLIA never stores raw card numbers on its servers.

settings.title: PRIMARY SETTLEMENT CURRENCY
settings.body: Version 01 orders settle in USD. International card issuers may apply standard foreign-exchange conversion where applicable.

settings.title: CUSTOMS & IMPORT DUTIES
settings.body: Where international shipping is active, destination VAT/GST or customs duties may apply unless explicitly displayed as Duties Paid at checkout.

settings.heading: PAYMENT & BILLING
settings.subtext: Complete your QIRÉLIA order via encrypted Shopify Checkout—cards, Apple Pay, Shop Pay, and transparent billing terms.
settings.accepted_methods_label: VISA  ·  MASTERCARD  ·  AMEX  ·  SHOP PAY  ·  APPLE PAY
settings.checkout_copy: For client security and PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance, QIRÉLIA never collects raw card credentials on storefront theme pages. Selecting Proceed to Checkout transfers your shopping bag directly into Shopify’s encrypted payment environment.
